# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This repository currently does not contain any application code or supported versions. If application code is added in the future, supported versions will be listed here.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this repository, please send an e-mail to the repository owner or open a private security advisory if supported by GitHub.

Please DO NOT report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.

We will try to review all reports and respond as quickly as possible.
